author: The Spiffing Brit
description:
Welcome to everyones favourite show on the internet (when you subtract all the other ones)! 
This is The Spiffing Brits perfrctly balanced adventure into the world of breaking indie games from small studios! Todays incredible new game is dungeon baller a brand new unreleased game from a handful of kiwis in new zealand! But first what is Dungeon baller? Well its a fun hybrid between backpack heros / Backpack battles. With influence from peglin and peggle with a healthy helping hand of slay the spire. In todays video I the spiffing brit master exploiter and bug enjoyer of video games will be destroying the early alpha playtest that I received from humble bundle. I know this is meant to be a simple fun game in an alpha state but that is not going to stop me from doing what I do best, CHAOS!
